title: Invoice
description: Data for the invoice template (templates/invoice/default.typ). typstgen also reads this file to embed a ZUGFeRD/Factur-X e-invoice.

$schema.description: URI of this schema, for editor support. Ignored by the templates.

customer_number.description: Customer number shown in the header.

due_date.description: Due date shown in the header. The closing sentence uses payment.due_date.

delivery_date.description: Delivery date. Not rendered; typstgen uses it for the ZUGFeRD e-invoice.

performance_period.description: Service period shown in the header. typstgen reads it as "MM/YYYY" for the ZUGFeRD e-invoice.

project_reference.description: Project reference shown above the salutation.

show_footer.description: Set to false to hide the company footer. Default: true.

recipient.description: Recipient shown in the DIN 5008 address window.

salutation.description: Opening of the letter. Omitted if absent or null.

greeting.description: Greeting line, e.g. "Sehr geehrte Frau Schmidt,".

position.description: Position number shown in the first column.

unit.description: Unit. The codes stueck, stunde, tag, monat, jahr, pauschale, kg, meter, kilometer, liter, karton, palette are abbreviated; any other text is printed as is.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate of the item, printed in the MwSt. column.

total.description: Net line total. The build stops if it differs from quantity × unit price by a cent or more.

sub_items.description: Detail lines printed below the description, joined with bullets. A leading "- " is stripped.

unit_code.description: UN/ECE Recommendation 20 unit code (e.g. HUR, C62, DAY) used by typstgen for the ZUGFeRD e-invoice. Not rendered.

totals.description: Precomputed totals; the template does not calculate them.

vat_breakdown.description: VAT per rate. The totals block (subtotal, VAT, total) is only rendered when this array is non-empty.

rate.description: The VAT rate of this group.

base.description: Net amount this rate applies to. Not rendered.

vat_total.description: Sum of all VAT amounts. Not rendered.

due_date.description: Payment due date, printed in the closing sentence and used by typstgen for the ZUGFeRD e-invoice.

payment_terms.description: Payment terms text. Not rendered; typstgen uses it for the ZUGFeRD e-invoice.

bank_account.description: Account to pay into. Not rendered (the footer uses company.json); typstgen uses it for the ZUGFeRD e-invoice.

amount.description: An amount in object form. The templates read `.amount`, so a plain number is not accepted here.

vat_rate_object.description: VAT rate in object form. The templates print `.percentage`, so a plain number is not accepted here.
